ARABIC — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Conversational skills.
